name: Al Zubarah Archaeological Site
description: Al Zubarah is a ruined walled pearling town on Qatar's northwest coast, about 105 km from Doha. Merchants from Kuwait founded it in the mid-18th century, and it grew into a busy trading port before its destruction in 1811. Desert sand preserved its palaces, mosques, courtyard houses, harbour and double walls, and only a small part has been excavated.
